_comment: Artifacts dotclaude once deployed into projects and no longer ships. scripts/prune-obsolete.py (run by init.sh/init.ps1 on every deploy) removes the matching hook entries from the project's .claude/settings*.json; gitHooks blocks (the tool's own start/end markers) are cut out of .git/hooks and an emptied hook is deleted; mcpServers and files are only REPORTED, because deleting a server or a directory the user may still rely on is their call. 'match' is a substring of the hook command; each hook has a / and a \ entry so both the POSIX form and the PowerShell & "<abs>\name.ps1" form are caught. check.py fails if an entry names a hook or MCP fragment dotclaude still ships, or matches a live central hook command.

gitHooks.reason: installed by `graphify hook install` (old init --serena); fails on every commit once Graphify is uninstalled
installed by `graphify hook install` (old init --serena); fails on every checkout once Graphify is uninstalled

mcpServers.reason: Serena was removed from dotclaude; the LSP plugin covers symbol navigation
